joint_credence_rule: All comparisons share the same previously examined population and change one joint working-model credence. No score identifies a language. A positive regional convention requires the primary pass rule, every leave-one-family-out gain positive, and a source-qualified sensitivity with positive gain; otherwise retain the shared-format model and leave local-language attribution unresolved.

predictions.statistic: Mean confirmation log2 probability gain of site-conditioned fine-variant prediction over a model using graphic context, carrier, material, motif, preservation and catalogue volume
predictions.null: Zero gain after recorded context; generated context-confounding and independent controls calibrate the scorer
predictions.pass_rule: Gain at least 0.03 bits, 95% component-bootstrap lower endpoint above zero, at least 100 components, at least three sites with 15 components each, every leave-one-graphic-family-out gain positive

predictions.statistic: Summed likelihood-ratio association of site and variant within exact fine-sign frames and matched carrier, motif, preservation and catalogue volume
predictions.null: Permute site labels within the frozen matching cells for 4999 draws
predictions.pass_rule: At least 30 components and five informative cells, p at most 0.05, no cell contributes over half the statistic
